tables.customers: People who place orders (also: buyers, clients, shoppers).
tables.products: Items for sale, each in one category (also: items, goods, merchandise).
tables.orders: One row per customer order, order grain (also: purchases).
tables.order_items: Line items; junction between orders and products, line grain (also: line items).
tables.reviews: Customer star ratings of products (also: ratings, feedback).

columns.customers.name: Customer full name.
columns.customers.signup_date: Date the customer registered (also: joined, registration date).
columns.categories.name: Category name (also: department, product type).
columns.products.name: Product name (also: item, title).
columns.products.price: Current list price in USD (also: list price, sticker price).
columns.products.cost: Unit cost to the business; margin = price - cost (also: unit cost, cogs).
columns.orders.order_date: Date the order was placed (also: purchase date, ordered on).
columns.orders.shipped_date: Date the order shipped; NULL if not shipped (also: shipping date, dispatched).
columns.orders.status: pending, shipped, delivered, cancelled or returned.
columns.orders.total_amount: Order grand total incl. shipping, net of discounts (also: revenue, sales, order value, order total). Use for revenue at ORDER level (by customer, country, month, status). Ambiguous with order_items.line_total.
columns.order_items.quantity: Units sold on this line (also: units, items sold).
columns.order_items.unit_price: Price per unit at purchase time (also: price paid, selling price).
columns.order_items.line_total: quantity * unit_price, merchandise only (also: revenue, sales, merchandise value, line value). Use for revenue at PRODUCT or CATEGORY level. Ambiguous with orders.total_amount.
columns.payments.method: card, paypal, bank_transfer or gift_card (also: payment type, payment method).
